svg.title: Synthetic benchmark under a shared external evaluator
svg.desc: External quality and common utility with population standard deviations across five seeds, normalised cost with deadline-miss rates, and the routing-mode mixture chosen by online SAGE.

svg.text: 2,500 tasks · 5 seeds · 500 tasks per seed · external nonlinear simulator

text.font-family: 'Linux Libertine O','Linux Libertine','Libertinus Serif','Times New Roman',Times,Georgia,serif

svg.text: Hidden capabilities, pair effects, quality, realised cost and realised

text.font-family: 'Linux Libertine O','Linux Libertine','Libertinus Serif','Times New Roman',Times,Georgia,serif

svg.text: latency all differ from the router’s own model, so SAGE’s probability

text.font-family: 'Linux Libertine O','Linux Libertine','Libertinus Serif','Times New Roman',Times,Georgia,serif

svg.text: never generates its own success label.

text.font-family: 'Linux Libertine O','Linux Libertine','Libertinus Serif','Times New Roman',Times,Georgia,serif

svg.text: (d) Route mixture chosen by Online SAGE

text.font-family: 'Linux Libertine O','Linux Libertine','Libertinus Serif','Times New Roman',Times,Georgia,serif

svg.text: Online SAGE buys its quality: +0.047 external quality over static SAGE for +0.107 of budget. The trade-off stays visible rather than hidden behind a capability-only score.

text.font-family: 'Linux Libertine O','Linux Libertine','Libertinus Serif','Times New Roman',Times,Georgia,serif

svg.text: Synthetic evidence about learning and constraint handling only. A publishable evaluation needs real executions, strong learned baselines, heterogeneous agents, trace replay, calibration analysis and adversarial conditions.
